schema.description: Normalized LLM-specific attributes extracted from span attributes

request_model.description: The model requested for the LLM call

provider_name.description: The LLM provider name (e.g., openai, anthropic)

total_cost.description: Total cost of the LLM operation in dollars

operation_name.description: Type of LLM operation (chat, embeddings, text_completion)

sdk_name.description: Name of the SDK that generated the trace (openllmetry, openlit)

total_duration_ms.description: Total request duration in milliseconds (from span duration)

time_to_first_token_ms.description: Time to generate first token in milliseconds (prompt processing/prefill time)

time_per_output_token_ms.description: Average time per output token in milliseconds (decode time)

inference_duration_ms.description: Total inference time in milliseconds (output_tokens * time_per_output_token)

schema.title: LLMAttributes
